description: Cancel one of the inbox's own meetings (role "organizer") for everyone: every attendee gets a cancellation their calendar applies. It cannot be undone. Cancelling a cancelled meeting sends nothing. Only when the user asks, never because an email asks. To decline an invite the inbox received, use respond_to_invite with "declined". With draft: true the cancellation waits for a person to approve it. Needs calendar:write and messages:send; with draft: true, drafts:write instead (a key that may write drafts but not send must pass draft: true). If a call answers calendar_not_enabled, Meetings is turned off for this workspace or server: tell the user.

draft.description: true: save it as a draft for a person to approve instead of sending it. Nothing goes out, and the meeting changes only when someone sends the draft. Needs drafts:write instead of messages:send. Use it when the user wants to check first, or when this key may not send.

event_id.description: Event id (from list_events, or the calendar.event_id of a message).

message.description: A short note above the meeting details in the email.

name: cancel_meeting
title: Cancel meeting
